verses.arabicText: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīr
verses.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalaw-wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūr
verses.translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqam-mā tarā fī khalqi r-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr
verses.translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-aw-wahuwa ḥasīr
verses.translation: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad zayyannā s-samāa d-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūmal-lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba s-saʿīr
verses.translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

verses.arabicText: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

verses.arabicText: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verses.transliteration: Idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqaw-wahiya tafūr
verses.translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

verses.arabicText: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīr
verses.translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīr
verses.translation: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi s-saʿīr
verses.translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

verses.arabicText: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qal-li-aṣḥābi s-saʿīr
verses.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratuw-wa-ajrun kabīr
verses.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

verses.arabicText: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr
verses.translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

verses.arabicText: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīr
verses.translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

verses.arabicText: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.transliteration: Huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū mir-riz'qihi wa-ilayhi n-nushūr
verses.translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

verses.arabicText: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verses.transliteration: A-amintum man fī s-samāi ay-yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūr
verses.translation: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Am amintum man fī s-samāi ay-yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr
verses.translation: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr
verses.translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilā ṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātiw-wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā r-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīr
verses.translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

verses.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verses.transliteration: Amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundul-lakum yanṣurukum min dūni r-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūr
verses.translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

verses.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.transliteration: Amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwiw-wanufūr
verses.translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

verses.arabicText: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Afamay-yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā ammay-yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭim-mus'taqīm
verses.translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu s-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlam-mā tashkurūn
verses.translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

verses.arabicText: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrum-mubīn
verses.translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūn
verses.translation: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu wamam-maʿiya aw raḥimanā famay-yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīm
verses.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa r-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālim-mubīn
verses.translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran famay-yatīkum bimāim-maʿīn
verses.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
